html:
Given a dictionary whose values are strings, return a dictionary mapping each value to the sorted list of original keys. Original keys are strings.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    {
      "b": "x",
      "a": "x",
      "c": "y"
    }
  ],
  "expected": {
    "x": [
      "a",
      "b"
    ],
    "y": [
      "c"
    ]
  }
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    {}
  ],
  "expected": {}
}
Hint

A value may correspond to several keys.

Complexity: O(n log n) time worst case, O(n) space

489 explicit tests pass across the 160 original exercises
